summary: Implemented the Alert Justification Feedback Loop: 5 new files + 4 modified, hexagonal (domain/application/infrastructure/presentation), backward-compatible via Optional[...] = None on EvaluateAlertsForTransactionHandler. New alert_justifications table (migration 0009, unique (user_id, category)). New POST /alerts/{id}/justify endpoint (204, 404 not-found/IDOR, 400 wrong-alert-type). Verified: 309 unit + 137 integration + 136 security all passing, zero change from pre-FINTRACK-25 baseline (full-suite combined run exceeds this sandbox's 45s cap, confirmed again this story -- per-suite is the accepted method). Manual smoke test (temp pytest file, deleted before push) exercised ceiling-suppression, above-ceiling still-fires, wrong-alert-type 400, cross-user 404 -- all passed. PR #38 real CI fully green: Test Suite success, Security Scan success, Detect Frontend success.

payload.architecture_decision: AlertJustification is keyed by (user_id, category), not per-alert: a per-category amount ceiling that only ever rises (AC2/AC4), mirroring FINTRACK-22's actual category+rolling-average LARGE_TRANSACTION detection rather than inventing merchant-pattern matching (Transaction has no merchant field). EvaluateAlertsForTransactionHandler gained an Optional[AlertJustificationRepository]=None constructor param -- None preserves FINTRACK-22's exact pre-existing behavior, so its original 24-test suite required zero changes. New POST /alerts/{id}/justify endpoint: 404 for both not-found and cross-user (IDOR-safe, matches DismissAlert's pattern), 400 for THRESHOLD_CROSSING alerts (AC7).
